description: N-terminal tripartite signal-peptide analysis and hydropathy profiles of ITIH5 isoforms 1-4
code:
import requests, json, re, time
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

seqs={}
for iso in ["Q86UX2-1","Q86UX2-2","Q86UX2-3","Q86UX2-4"]:
    t = requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{iso}.fasta", timeout=60).text
    seqs[iso]="".join(t.strip().split("\n")[1:])

KD = dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,
          L=3.8,K=-3.9,M=1.9,F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
def kd_profile(s, w=9):
    v=[KD[a] for a in s]
    return np.array([np.mean(v[max(0,i-w//2):i+w//2+1]) for i in range(len(v))])

print("=== N-terminal tripartite (von Heijne) analysis, first 40 residues ===")
rows=[]
for iso,s in seqs.items():
    nt = s[:40]
    netchg = sum(1 for a in nt[:10] if a in "KR") - sum(1 for a in nt[:10] if a in "DE")
    # longest run of hydrophobic/neutral residues (h-region candidate) in first 30
    hyd = set("AVLIMFWCGP")
    best, cur, bstart = 0,0,None; st=None
    for i,a in enumerate(nt[:30]):
        if a in hyd:
            cur+=1
            if st is None: st=i
            if cur>best: best, bstart = cur, st
        else: cur=0; st=None
    kdmax = kd_profile(s[:40],7).max() if len(s)>=40 else None
    rows.append((iso,len(s),nt[:20],netchg,best,bstart+1 if bstart is not None else None,round(float(kdmax),2)))
    print(f"{iso}: len={len(s):4d} Nterm20={nt[:20]} n-region(1-10) net charge={netchg:+d} "
          f"longest hydrophobic run(1-30)={best} aa at pos {bstart+1 if bstart is not None else '-'} maxKD(w7,1-40)={kdmax:.2f}")

print("\n=== Other targeting signals ===")
import re as _re
for iso,s in seqs.items():
    mono = _re.findall(r"[KR]{4,6}", s[:60])
    kdel = s.endswith(("KDEL","HDEL","KKXX")) 
    # mito-like: first 25 res, R-rich, no acidic
    m25=s[:25]; acid=sum(1 for a in m25 if a in "DE"); basic=sum(1 for a in m25 if a in "KR")
    print(f"{iso}: basic-cluster in 1-60: {mono}  ER-retention C-term: {kdel}  "
          f"first25 basic={basic} acidic={acid} (mito-presequence pattern needs basic>=3, acidic=0)")

# ---- Figure: hydropathy of N-terminal 60 residues, all isoforms ----
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1,4, figsize=(16,3.6), sharey=True)
for ax,(iso,s) in zip(axes, seqs.items()):
    p = kd_profile(s[:60],9)
    ax.plot(range(1,len(p)+1), p, color="#2b6cb0", lw=1.8)
    ax.axhline(1.6, color="#c53030", ls="--", lw=1, label="SP h-region threshold 1.6")
    ax.axhline(0, color="grey", lw=0.6)
    ax.fill_between(range(1,len(p)+1), 1.6, p, where=(p>1.6), color="#c53030", alpha=0.25)
    ax.set_title(f"{iso} ({len(s)} aa)\nPhobius SP: {'yes' if iso in ('Q86UX2-1','Q86UX2-2') else 'no'}", fontsize=10)
    ax.set_xlabel("residue")
axes[0].set_ylabel("Kyte-Doolittle (w=9)")
axes[0].legend(fontsize=7)
plt.suptitle("ITIH5 isoforms: N-terminal 60-residue hydropathy. Only isoforms 1 and 2 carry a hydrophobic h-region", fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
